abstract:
This article analyzes the formation of the gut microbiome in children, its impact 
on the body, and the main influencing factors. The role of birth mode, feeding type, and 
environmental conditions in the development of intestinal microbiota is also discussed.

title: COMPARATIVE DIAGNOSIS OF INFLUENZA AND COVID-19
abstract:
This article examines the epidemiological characteristics and clinical course of 
influenza and COVID-19 infections. Similarities and differences between the two viral diseases are 
analyzed, and criteria important for differential diagnosis are provided. The study results can be applied in 
clinical practice to establish accurate diagnoses and determine effective treatment measures.
